outcome.answer: Yes: [1] and [2] are the closest matches. [1] studies GNNs as fast computational surrogates for linear SDPs, showing that standard GNNs fail but a more expressive architecture can recover optimal SDP solutions and warm-start a solver. [2] is a Max-Cut-specific neural proxy for SDP solvers that predicts primal- and dual-feasible SDP solutions and can be plugged into exact branch-and-bound.
